name: Strong Wind Cycling
description: Strong winds create elevated safety and stability risks for cyclists.
advice: Avoid cycling because strong winds create a severe safety and stability risk.

name: High UV Outdoor Exercise
description: Intense solar radiation during peak hours can cause rapid sunburn and heat stress.
advice: Limit intense outdoor exercise during peak UV hours; seek shade and apply broad-spectrum sunscreen.

name: Heavy Rain Running
description: Heavy rainfall causes low visibility, pooling water, and slippery footpaths.
advice: Avoid outdoor running due to heavy rainfall, reduced visibility, and slip hazards.

name: Moderate Rain Walking
description: Elevated rain chance during walking; non-critical caution required.
advice: Carry an umbrella or water-resistant gear when walking under probable rain conditions.

name: High Rain Probability Travel
description: High chance of rainfall during transit can disrupt traffic and cause delays.
advice: Expect potential transit delays and reduced road traction; check route alerts before traveling.

name: Strong Wind Two-Wheeler
description: Severe crosswinds make two-wheeled transport unstable and hazardous.
advice: Exercise extreme caution or postpone riding two-wheelers; high crosswinds significantly increase crash risk.

name: Extreme Heat Outdoor Activity
description: Dangerous ambient temperatures increase susceptibility to heat exhaustion and stroke.
advice: Reschedule non-essential outdoor exertion; extreme temperatures create dangerous heat illness risks.

name: High UV Child Protection
description: Children's sensitive skin is especially vulnerable to acute UV radiation damage.
advice: Keep children out of direct sun during extreme UV levels; ensure protective clothing, hats, and sunscreen.

name: Extreme Heat Elderly Advisory
description: Senior citizens have impaired thermoregulation and face high risk during extreme heat.
advice: Advise elderly individuals to remain in cool, shaded, or air-conditioned environments during extreme heat.

name: Rain Child Park
description: Wet park equipment poses slip hazards and discomfort for children.
advice: Postpone park visits with children due to wet play structures, mud, and high likelihood of rain.

name: Suitable Picnic Conditions
description: Holistic check confirming weather conditions are generally pleasant for an outdoor picnic.
advice: Current conditions are mild and generally suitable for a picnic or outdoor leisure.

name: Thunderstorm / Severe Weather Override
description: Dangerous thunderstorm or severe weather system detected. This situational override outranks ALL ordinary activity-specific advisories regardless of the planned activity.
advice: SITUATIONAL OVERRIDE: Dangerous severe weather conditions detected with strong wind gusts and heavy precipitation indicating a possible thunderstorm system. ALL outdoor activities should be postponed immediately. Seek shelter indoors and monitor local weather alerts. This advisory supersedes all activity-specific guidance.
